                      Why these groups and types

                      Jobs group by the question version they pin; Tasks group as Prep, then Data, Information, Knowledge, Wisdom and Executive; each answer Task holds one Run per segment. Groups add no folders.

                      A type names a responsibility from the contract; the files carry no job-type or task-type field.

                      The live Jobs page still groups the prep Task by number; the name Prep is not in its navigation yet.
